sections.heading: New
items: GPT Image 2 can generate and edit images with your signed-in Codex subscription allowance
Codex is preferred by default while Fal.ai image models remain selectable
Provider failures never switch silently to a different credential or billing source

sections.heading: New
items: CreatorStudio Editor uses your CreatorStudio Fal.ai connection for image and video generation
Local Fal.ai fallback and ElevenLabs credentials are stored in macOS Keychain
ClickCampaigns GodMode controls protected features while existing projects remain editable and exportable
